paragraphs: In Berakhot 22a and Chullin 136b, accepted practice follows these three elders: Rabbi Ilai, Rabbi Yoshiyah and Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Accepted practice is reported as the cited sources’ statement, not offered as present-day legal guidance.

The consulted William Davidson Berakhot 22a paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Ilai, Rabbi Yoshiyah and Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira as the three elders. The selected Chullin 136b paragraph repeats the three-elders formula and names Rabbi Ilai at that point. These are historical statements of the cited texts; no further legal material or present-day ruling is supplied.
